verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online exposes a REST API and an official MCP server with full CRUD across 29 entity types (likely including journal entries), so an agent could programmatically draft and post entries via API [quickbooks-gh-3][quickbooks-gh-4][quickbooks-docs-36]. However, there is no evidence of a built-in 'draft/pending review queue' workflow for AI-created journal entries, nor documentation of an accountant-facing approval step for API-posted entries beyond generic 'give your accountant access' (quickbooks-docs-10), which is not the same as a review queue. Missing for 10: explicit journal-entry-specific API examples, a documented draft/pending status or approval workflow, and evidence of accountant review tooling tied to AI-created entries.
